news.title: No independent directors
news.body: Following the recent departure of a director, there are no independent directors on the board. The company's board is composed of: No independent directors. 6 non-independent directors. Additional Director Tanya Jha was the last director to join the board, commencing their role in 2025. The company's lack of independent directors is a risk according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.29 (vs ₹0.23 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.29 (up from ₹0.23 in 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹729.0k (up 28% from 3Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 16% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 30% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.title: New minor risk - Profit margin trend
news.body: The company's profit margins are lower than last year and have reduced by more than 30%. Net profit margin: 191% Last year net profit margin: 347% This is considered a minor risk. A large drop in profit margin could indicate the company does not have strong competitive advantages or it is yet to establish itself and its core business. Even if it is a well established business, this may make it a much riskier investment than one that has a combination of proven competitive advantages and a stable or growing profit margin. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risks Shares are highly illiquid. Revenue is less than US$1m (₹924k revenue, or US$10k). Market cap is less than US$10m (₹215.8m market cap, or US$2.43m). Minor Risk Profit margins are more than 30%
